'''The Unit''' was a group of close-knit friends consisting of [[Valin Horn]], [[Jysella Horn]], [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], and [[Bazel Warv]]. The group went through difficult times as all four of them suffered from the effects of a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-related [[Force psychosis|illness]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].
